newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales total $232 mln for Thursday, April 3.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales total $232 mln for Thursday, April 3.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Thursday, April 3 are expected to total $232 million in 13 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $197 million in three sales, with a $136 million Connecticut Health and Educational Financing Authority deal through Lehman Brothers topping the the list.
On the competitive side, 10 sales totaling $35 million are on the schedule, a $9 million New Jersey Educational Facility Authority deal at 1100 EST is the largest.
An additional two sales totaling $71 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Thursday, depending on market conditions.
